task: RADAR+PWV -> future RADAR; no RAIN target, no DEM input
missing_data: Exclude discontinuous windows; no filling or temporal interpolation
boundaries: All 30 frames of each window stay in the assigned year/month partition

methods.deterministic: 0.396M common convolutional deterministic reference; not proposed as a new research backbone
methods.ddpm: 1.152M direct conditional pixel-space diffusion, cosine schedule, velocity prediction, DDIM sampling
methods.resdiff: 1.157M conditional residual diffusion plus the separately trained/frozen common predictor; not a full DiffCast reproduction
methods.flow: 1.152M direct conditional rectified-flow matching with straight noise-to-data paths and Euler sampling; not a full FlowCast reproduction

shared_network: Joint 20-frame channel representation, radar/PWV condition encoder, 24/48/96 feature widths, timestep FiLM; no attention, recurrence, Mamba, GAN or latent compression

losses.standard: deterministic MSE; diffusion velocity MSE; flow velocity MSE
losses.weighted: deterministic normalized weighted MSE; generative native MSE plus confidence-weighted 0.5*reconstruction weighted MSE
losses.skill: weighted recipe plus confidence-weighted 0.03*softCSI + 0.05*FSS3 loss + 0.05*temporal-difference L1
losses.interpretation: Reconstruction/skill losses are experimental bias terms, not guaranteed probabilistic calibration or a new physical law

screen.training_examples_per_epoch: All eligible training windows, uniform shuffled without replacement
screen.validation_screen: 768 equally spaced validation issue windows, selected without labels
screen.full_validation: Re-rank the three selected screen checkpoints plus final checkpoint on ALL validation windows
screen.reuse: R1 unchanged deterministic recipes and the controlled standardized DDPM standard pilot may be reused only after strict provenance, behavior and full-validation count checks. Every formal run is fresh.

formal.initialization: All formal seeds from scratch; same maximum/minimum/patience rules for each method; early stopping only on validation screen
formal.recipe: Chosen separately per round and method using screening FULL validation only
formal.checkpoint_selection: Best three validation-screen checkpoints plus actual final epoch, re-ranked on full validation

optimization.reproducibility: Fixed issue order within a seed/epoch, saved optimizer/scheduler/RNG states, deterministic algorithms

selection.primary: Internal ranking: equal-weight validation CSI across 20/30/40 dBZ and T+30/60/90/120
selection.tie_break: Within CSI tie band maximize 0.5*POD - 0.5*FAR + 0.25*FSS3 over the same validation points
selection.undefined_FAR: Count as 1 for internal tie-break only; reported metric remains undefined
selection.reports: All 20 lead times, all 3 dBZ thresholds; the internal ranking scalar never replaces lead-time curves

generation.noise: Fixed per issue identity and member, independent of batch size; never choose the best member using truth
generation.outputs: Physical 0..50 dBZ, stored/scored as FP16 dBZ; member 0 full fields and all-member statistics retained

evaluation.FSS_border_convention: Truncated neighborhoods; divide by real cell count
evaluation.pooling: Pool hit/false-alarm/miss counts and FSS numerator/denominator across issues separately per lead/threshold
evaluation.primary_generative_summary: Mean of individually evaluated fixed-member skill curves; show spread across members and 3 training seeds
evaluation.secondary: Member-0 and ensemble-mean field skill explicitly labeled; no best-of-N scores
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired contiguous 72-hour block bootstrap within each round; never treat overlapping windows as independent storms
evaluation.qualitative: Truth-selected independent-day cases, identical dBZ scale, input/ground truth/all models, 30/60/90/120 min; retain failure cases
evaluation.compute: Parameter counts, total residual-model parameters including base, training and inference time, peak GPU memory

paper_scope: Lightweight method comparison on this dataset, not reproduction of original published SOTA scores and not a claim of a publishable novel architecture

normalization.fit: Each round uses only unique RADAR target frames from its own training split
normalization.inverse: All outputs restored and clipped to the identical physical 0..50 dBZ range
normalization.inputs: Same fixed physical RADAR/50 and PWV/80; future PWV prohibited
normalization.evidence: Controlled R1 pilot improves CSI and FAR at every lead/threshold; test remained unseen

revision.reason: Verified training-target normalization; validation-controlled convergence budget
